articles.title: Russia begins three days of nuclear drills
articles.summary: On October 26, 2022, Russia test-fired a Yars intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) as part of extensive nuclear drills. Originating from Moscow, this exercise showcased Russia's strategic deterrence capabilities and readiness of its advanced weapon systems. Such missile tests are critical for maintaining operational effectiveness and validate military prowess, significantly influencing global defence dynamics and strategic stability considerations.

articles.title: 22k gold rate today: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (May 19, 2026) on IBJA, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Tanishq and Kalyan Jewellers
articles.summary: Gold and silver prices rose across India today, including major jewellery brands and IBJA, driven by mixed global economic signals. This highlights how international economic indicators directly impact domestic commodity markets. For SSB aspirants, understanding these linkages between global events and national economic trends is crucial for current affairs knowledge and for developing a comprehensive perspective on economic dynamics.

articles.title: Green hydrogen to cut LPG dependence for cooking: PSA Ajay Sood
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government is exploring green hydrogen as a household cooking fuel to significantly reduce India's dependence on imported LPG. This strategic move aims to enhance national energy security, promote cleaner alternatives, and cut import bills. The initiative underscores a commitment to sustainable energy solutions and self-reliance, potentially transforming domestic energy consumption.

articles.title: Operation Sindoor reflected 'smart power' in its most complete expression, says Indian Army chief
articles.summary: Under Operation Sindoor, Indian forces successfully dismantled significant terror infrastructure, strategically challenging a long-standing assumption about India's response capabilities. The operation was executed deliberately and purposefully, stopping upon achieving its objectives. This precise action showcases India's resolve to conduct targeted operations, demonstrating strategic thinking and tactical control crucial for national security.

articles.title: Ro Fund Management launches ‘Ro Stars of India Fund’ under Category III AIF platform
articles.summary: Mumbai-based Ro Fund Management has launched the 'Ro Stars of India Fund,' a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund (AIF). This new fund aims to generate high-alpha returns for investors by employing a strategy focused on identifying promising Indian businesses. It represents a notable development in the domestic investment landscape, providing new avenues for wealth creation within the national economy.

articles.title: Malaysia seeks over US$251 million in compensation from Norwegian firm over scrapped missile deal: Minister
articles.summary: A minister announced that 30% of combat ship project components are currently locally sourced, expressing hope to increase this figure in future naval projects. This underscores India's strong push towards enhancing indigenous manufacturing and achieving greater self-reliance in the defence sector. Such initiatives are vital for strengthening national security, reducing foreign dependency, and boosting the domestic defence industry, aligning with the 'Make in India' vision.

articles.title: Cast your vote for the Oshkosh and Fond du Lac Athlete of the Week
articles.summary: This article announces the 'Athlete of the Week' poll for the Oshkosh and Fond du Lac areas, covering athletic achievements from May 11-17. Readers are encouraged to vote for local high school athletes who excelled in sports like baseball and girls' soccer. The poll closes on May 22, aiming to recognize and celebrate community sports talent within these specific regions. While relevant locally, aspiring candidates should prioritize news of national and international strategic significance.

articles.title: Russia begins three days of nuclear drills
articles.summary: Russia initiated three-day nuclear weapons drills involving thousands of troops nationwide, amid escalating drone attacks from Kyiv. This exercise highlights Russia's nuclear readiness and strategic messaging, particularly given the ongoing conflict. It serves as a significant display of military might and a powerful strategic deterrence signal to international observers and adversaries.
